# Little Flower School, Salempur

> Little Flower School (LFS), Salempur is a premier co-educational Christian minority institution affiliated with the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE), New Delhi (ICSE Class X and ISC Class XII). Established and administered by the Little Flower Mission Education Society, Gorakhpur (CST Fathers), the school has been dedicated to academic excellence, moral integrity, and holistic student development for decades with the motto "For God and Man".

## Quick Facts
- **Institution Name**: Little Flower School, Salempur (LFS Salempur)
- **Affiliation**: CISCE (Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations, New Delhi)
- **Curriculum Levels**: LKG to Class XII (ICSE 10th & ISC 12th Science / Commerce / Humanities)
- **Management**: Little Flower Mission Education Society, Gorakhpur (CST Fathers)
- **Principal**: Fr. Jubish Thomas CST
- **Manager**: Fr. Benoy Mathew CST
- **Location**: Salempur, Deoria District, Uttar Pradesh - 274509, India
- **Phone**: +91 94533 44112, +91 87659 32092
- **Email**: littleflowersalempur@gmail.com
- **Official Website**: https://www.lfssalempur.com/
- **Online Fee Portal**: https://www.lfssalempur.online/payonline/

## Core Sections & URLs

- [Homepage](https://www.lfssalempur.com/): Welcome, mission, announcements, leadership messages, and campus highlights.
- [About Us](https://www.lfssalempur.com/about): History, vision, core pillars (Love, Justice, Truth), management, succession of Principals, and code of discipline.
- [Academics](https://www.lfssalempur.com/academics): ICSE and ISC curriculum framework, subject streams, holistic pedagogy, and flex-care support.
- [Admissions](https://www.lfssalempur.com/admissions): Admission process for LKG to VIII, fee structure guidelines, entrance assessment, and prospectus download.
- [Achievers](https://www.lfssalempur.com/achievers): Board examination toppers in ICSE (Class 10) and ISC (Class 12), merit lists, and academic honors.
- [Campus & Facilities](https://www.lfssalempur.com/campus): Well-equipped science laboratories (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), computer labs, digital library, sports grounds, chapel, and smart classrooms.
- [Events & Calendar](https://www.lfssalempur.com/events): Academic calendar, parent-teacher meetings (PTM), annual sports, science exhibitions, and cultural programs.
- [Examinations](https://www.lfssalempur.com/exams): Exam schedules, assessment schemes, board exam notices, and admit card instructions.
- [Gallery](https://www.lfssalempur.com/gallery): High-resolution photo galleries of celebrations, campus infrastructure, sports day, and national festivals.
- [Alumni Network](https://www.lfssalempur.com/alumni): Notable alumni across Civil Services, Medicine, Engineering, Law, and Armed Forces; alumni directory and registration.
- [Contact Us](https://www.lfssalempur.com/contact): Location map, office hours, enquiry form, phone numbers, and WhatsApp assistance.
